Rewriting expressions for numerical evaluation

Source: R/codegen-rewriting.R
codegen-rewriting.Rd

ReplaceOptim(query, value) is an optimization that replaces the subexpressions matching query by value, as SymPy's ReplaceOptim. sym_optimize(expr, optimizations) applies optimizations in order of decreasing priority, keeping the cheaper expression when an optimization has a cost function (SymPy's optimize()). FuncMinusOneOptim(func, func_m_1) rewrites sums such as exp(x) - 1 as expm1(x), and create_expand_pow_optimization(limit) writes small integer powers as repeated products.

Usage

ReplaceOptim(query, value, cost_function = NULL, priority = 1)

sym_optimize(expr, optimizations)

exp2_opt(expr)

sinc_opt1(expr)

sinc_opt2(expr)

sinc_opts

log2_opt(expr)

log2const_opt(expr)

logsumexp_2terms_opt(expr)

FuncMinusOneOptim(func, func_m_1, opportunistic = TRUE)

expm1_opt(expr)

cosm1_opt(expr)

powm1_opt(expr)

log1p_opt(expr)

create_expand_pow_optimization(limit, base_req = NULL)

matinv_opt(expr)

logaddexp_opt(expr)

logaddexp2_opt(expr)

optims_c99

optims_numpy

optims_scipy

Arguments

query

A pattern with wild symbols, the name of a function or node type, or an R predicate of a node.

value

The replacement: an expression (using the wild symbols of a pattern), or an R function of the matched wild symbols (for a pattern), of the arguments (for a name) or of the node (for a predicate).

cost_function

NULL, or an R function giving the cost of an expression.

priority

Optimizations of higher priority are applied first.

expr

An expression.

optimizations

A list of optimizations.

func, func_m_1

R functions building f(x) and f(x) - 1 (such as exp and sym_expm1), or their names.

opportunistic

Whether to rewrite whenever the constant term gets smaller, rather than only when it cancels.

limit

The largest exponent to expand.

base_req

An R predicate on the base of a power; the default accepts symbols.

Value

An optimization (an R function of an expression), or for sym_optimize() an expression.

Details

The predefined optimizations are exp2_opt, sinc_opt1, sinc_opt2, log2_opt, log2const_opt, logsumexp_2terms_opt, expm1_opt, cosm1_opt, powm1_opt, log1p_opt, matinv_opt, logaddexp_opt and logaddexp2_opt, with the collections sinc_opts, optims_c99, optims_numpy and optims_scipy. matinv_opt rewrites the product of Inverse(A) and a column x as MatrixSolve(A, x) when the assumptions context holds Q$fullrank(A) for the matrix symbol A (see assuming() and global_assumptions).

Examples

x <- Symbol("x")
sym_optimize(3*exp(x) - 3, list(expm1_opt))
#> 3*expm1(x)
sym_optimize(log(x)/log(Integer(2)) + log(x + 1), optims_c99)
#> log1p(x) + log2(x)
ccode(sym_optimize(x^4 + x^2, list(create_expand_pow_optimization(4))))
#> [1] "x*x + x*x*x*x"
